_meta.note: Captured through Kiro Crew's own AcpClient and PiLaunch with the in-product frame recorder (KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES): pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.4.0 (the lane pin, npm ci in test/real_adapters), with Kiro Crew's gate extension loaded through the gate launcher (PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND) and this launch's steer channel named in KIROCREW_PI_STEER and keyed by KIROCREW_PI_STEER_KEY (acp.harness.pi_steer). The recording host refuses user namespaces, so the client ran with sandbox_mode off and the routing's sandbox preflight and the pi Node probe's sandbox wrap were stood in for. The model is a scripted OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the loopback interface named in pi's own models.json; the client set that model at startup (the set-model answer is id 3). The model called bash `sleep 4 && echo done`; the client answered the gate's session/request_permission yes; one second later the client steered 'Also tell me the word PINEAPPLE.', which AcpClient wrote as a sealed steer file (no wire frame: the steer bypasses the adapter), and steer() answered True. At the turn_end after the tool result the extension queued it on pi's steering queue with pi.sendMessage(deliverAs: steer), which pi hands the model as a user message; when pi started that message the extension notified the consumed envelope (kiro-crew-steer, the gate nonce), forwarded by pi-acp as an agent_message_chunk carrying _meta.piAcp.notify; the model's next request carried the steer as the latest user message and its answer named the word, and the same session/prompt ended end_turn. Reductions: 3 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 3 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the scratch working directory is replaced with <cwd>; the session id is replaced with the synthetic pi-session-1; the confirm dialogs' uuids are replaced with synthetic pi-ui-perm-N ids.
